title: Checkout API down: database connection pool exhausted
symptoms: HTTP 503 spike, timeout acquiring connection from pool, too many connections, p99 latency 30s, traffic spike during flash sale
root_cause: Connection pool max_size=20 too small for peak traffic; slow query held connections open
resolution: Raise DB pool max_size from 20 to 60 via config and rolling restart

title: Search service crash-looping after v2.14 deploy (memory leak)
symptoms: OOMKilled, pod restarts, CrashLoopBackOff, memory climbing steadily after deploy, java.lang.OutOfMemoryError heap space
root_cause: v2.14 introduced unbounded in-memory cache of query results
resolution: Roll back to v2.13 with kubectl rollout undo
Open bug for cache eviction policy
Add memory-growth canary check to pipeline

title: Payments gateway rejecting calls: TLS certificate expired
symptoms: x509 certificate has expired, SSL handshake failed, tls verify error, all payment requests failing, sudden start at midnight UTC
root_cause: Auto-renewal job for the upstream client certificate silently failed 30 days earlier
resolution: Issue new certificate from internal CA
Deploy secret to payments namespace and restart gateway

title: Auth latency spike from Redis cache stampede
symptoms: login latency 8s, redis timeout, cache miss ratio 95%, thundering herd after cache flush, CPU high on primary database
root_cause: Mass key expiry at the same TTL caused simultaneous cache misses hitting the DB
resolution: Enable request coalescing on session lookup

title: Orders worker halted: disk full on log volume
symptoms: no space left on device, write failed, disk usage 100% on /var/log, worker stopped processing, debug logging left on
root_cause: Debug logging enabled during earlier investigation was never turned off; logrotate misconfigured
resolution: Set log level back to INFO

title: API gateway 502s after nginx config change
symptoms: 502 bad gateway, upstream prematurely closed connection, no live upstreams, started right after config push
root_cause: Upstream block pointed to renamed service DNS name
resolution: Revert gateway config to previous commit
Reload nginx and confirm upstream health
Add config lint and staging smoke test

title: Kafka consumer lag after rebalance storm
symptoms: consumer lag growing, frequent rebalance, session timeout, partitions revoked, processing delayed by hours
root_cause: Long message processing exceeded max.poll.interval.ms triggering repeated rebalances
resolution: Scale consumers to match partition count

title: CDN 5xx storm: origin overloaded after marketing campaign
symptoms: origin 504 gateway timeout, CDN cache hit ratio dropped, traffic 6x normal, uncached personalised pages
root_cause: Campaign landing page had cache-busting query parameters so every request hit origin
resolution: Strip campaign query params at the CDN

title: Stale reads from database replica lag
symptoms: users see old data, replication lag 300s, replica behind primary, long running batch job writing heavily
root_cause: Nightly batch job overloaded replication stream
resolution: Route critical reads to primary temporarily

title: Intermittent failures from DNS resolution errors
symptoms: temporary failure in name resolution, UnknownHostException, coredns pods throttled, intermittent timeouts across many services
root_cause: CoreDNS under-provisioned CPU limits, throttled during peak
resolution: Raise CoreDNS CPU limit and replicas
